summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (invoked as `node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, stages it in a temporary directory, and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated 727KB bundle exhibiting obfuscator.io fingerprints: a shuffled string-array with a rotation function (`WV8StW`), a character-map decoder (`hc1jfK9`), and mangled identifiers. The setup.mjs preinstall script itself is also obfuscated in obfuscator.io style, with hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `_0x19328d`) and per-function lookup-object indirection wrapping calls such as `execFileSync`. A Vue merge-tag input component has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time. Bringing in a second runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling payload is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that bypasses Node-based install-time scanners and hands arbitrary code execution to every installer on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
